## Highlights
### New
- On iPhone and iPad, Start on new tab in General settings opens Crest on a new tab in your default Space, ready to search.
### Improved
- On iPhone the sidebar stays full screen. Turn on Allow floating sidebar in General settings to float it over the page instead. - A Space’s Search with menu shows each provider’s icon, like the default search menu. - Each section in Settings has its own color, drawn from the Space templates.
### Fixed
- Buttons in the floating sidebar respond to taps, and its Settings button opens Settings. - Settings on iPhone and iPad shows Crest’s real app icon, including the one you chose, in light and dark. - On iPhone and iPad, General settings shows whether Crest is your default browser instead of Unavailable when iOS limits how often Crest can check. - Edit Shortcuts and Add Provider in Search settings open right away on iPhone and iPad.
---
Development builds contain the newest changes and may be less reliable than stable releases.

## Highlights
### Fixed
- Downloads follow the Automatic Downloads choice of the site you’re on, including files it serves from another address, such as GitHub release files. A blocked download’s message no longer appears twice. - Chromium pages use your default zoom when they open and keep your chosen zoom as you navigate. - Chromium is updated to 154.0.8037.57 with upstream security and compatibility fixes.
